camera: Flat front-facing portrait UI; no 3D preview. A large modal card-detail popup sits over a dimmed collection screen.

hudLayout.topThird: Persistent header: top-left a tilted brown leather chapter book with a big gold '2' and 'CHAPTER'; top-right three dark rounded counter slots in a row (gold hexagon coin 57, green star 86, magenta meeple 3.64K); below them a six-segment progress bar, first segment olive-filled, with '0/6' at right. Second row on a wood-plank strip: left a gold 'CLAIM BOUNTY' button with a green star icon, centre a khaki 'UPGRADE CARDS' button with an up arrow and a '0/1' bar, right a rolled parchment quest scroll with a red wax seal. Third row: a khaki 'COLLECTION' title bar with a '3/31' counter pill, an 'UPGRADE' button with a magnifier icon, and a red 'X' close button; then two tabs 'MAIN' and 'EVENTS'. All of this is dimmed behind the modal.
hudLayout.middleThird: The modal: a wide khaki parchment panel from ~27% to ~72% of screen height, near full width with a small margin. Centre: title 'Bone Crusher' in cream bold text, below it a large portrait card with a thick purple rarity frame and grey inner bevel showing a dark, locked ogre portrait with a big white padlock, a black pill 'Speed x 1' on the frame bottom, and the flavour line 'Loves killing skellies!' under it. Left column: two gear sub-cards stacked (top 'Rotten Flesh Vest' with a leather vest image, padlock, caption 'Leather biker vest', pill 'Crit Bonus x 1'; bottom 'Bone Bat' with a bone club image, padlock, caption 'Nothing like the crack of the bat', pill 'Crit Chance x 1'). Right column: top slot is an empty darker khaki panel with only the pill 'Crit Luck x 1'; bottom 'Bone Bucket' with a bone pail image, padlock, caption 'Made from bones for collecting bones', pill 'Pack Size x 1'.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Below the modal the dimmed collection grid continues: a 3-column grid of card tiles reading 'Unlock at Chapter 4', 'Unlock at Chapter 5', 'Unlock at Chapter 5', then a row of three padlocked dark cards (backpack, ogre, bucket). Bottom nav strip on wood: stacked cards icon left-centre, 'username' centred, wooden chest icon and a steel cog settings button right, 'fps: 60.02' debug text bottom-left.

uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice panels and buttons with rounded corners, darker front lips and small notches; card frames are thick bevelled slabs coloured by rarity (purple, teal, grey); black rounded stat pills with white bold text; bold sans-serif labels with heavy weight.
colorPalette: Warm khaki/parchment modal dominates the centre, framed by dim umber wood and dark near-black-blue behind; one saturated purple rarity frame and a red close button are the accents; portraits are dark and desaturated because locked.
mood: Grounded fantasy collection screen, a little grim from the locked dark portraits.
composition: Symmetric modal: big hero card centre as focal point, four gear slots in the corners, title on top, flavour text below; header and grid recede under a dim overlay.
